guarantees.claim: round_key_sel is continuously driven as the enum cast of round_key_sel_raw using round_key_sel_e type.
mux_sel_err is the bitwise OR of state_sel_err, add_rk_sel_err, key_full_sel_err, key_dec_sel_err, key_words_sel_err, and round_key_sel_err.

assumptions.claim: round_key_sel_raw always holds a value that is a valid member of the round_key_sel_e enumerated type.
assumptions.risk: Casting an out-of-range value may produce an undefined/invalid round_key_sel, which can cause incorrect round key selection before the error signal is asserted and the FSM locks up.

uncertain_points.claim: If round_key_sel_raw is not a valid enum value, the resulting invalid round_key_sel may propagate to downstream AES logic before round_key_sel_err (and hence mux_sel_err) triggers an FSM freeze.
uncertain_points.risk: An incorrect round key could be used for one or more AES rounds, potentially compromising security or causing silent data corruption before the system halts.

uncertain_points.claim: mux_sel_err is intended to be connected to a control FSM that locks up and triggers an alert when any selector error is asserted, but that connection is not shown in this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: Without proper connection, invalid multiplexer selections may not cause a safe lockdown/alert, leading to silent incorrect operation.
